Overview

This is the Aggieland Farmers Market located in the Post Oak Mall parking lot in front of Murdoch’s. We are open every Saturday rain or shine. We are an 80-20 market, so 80% farmers and 20% others. There are all kinds of items to get like fresh veggies, meats, jams & jellies, all kinds of fresh bread, baked goodies, freeze dried products and live music.
